runSummary.stalePolicy: Discovery age is not verification age. LIVE requires fresh full-detail/link evidence; list/search resurfacing cannot set verifiedAt.
runSummary.note: Fresh locality-gated sweep actually searched Profesia, direct-company/public ATS, LinkedIn, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Pretlak, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. One exact WooCommerce product-admin candidate was readable on Upwork but was posted three weeks ago, already has one hire/four interviews and 20-50 proposals, so it was not promoted. Facebook has 0 verified hits. Existing LIVE jobs remain fail-closed because safe complete jobs-data.json round-trip replacement cannot be guaranteed by the current repository read surface.

developmentChanges.title: Candidate saturation decay
developmentChanges.reason: Combine proposal count, interviews, hires and time since publication into a saturation score so otherwise strong freelance matches automatically lose priority once the realistic reply probability collapses.

developmentChanges.title: Zero-result source evidence ledger
developmentChanges.reason: Persist the exact source family, query intent and timestamp even when a search returns no usable hit, preventing future audits from confusing genuinely checked sources with sources that were never queried.
